page.overview:
Who is Bleeker?

Bleeker was a male Human who served the Galactic Empire's Imperial Intelligence on the planet Coruscant by the year 3 BBY. In that year, they worked in the Tech Section of Intelligence under the scientist Royd Pew, who had them test experimental parawings being developed by Tech. They performed one test while Pew and Intelligence agent Jahan Cross observed, which failed due to Bleeker crashing almost instantly to the ground. Despite Bleeker's display, Cross took a pair of the parawings, claiming that Bleeker failed due to the fact that they lacked experience at pit racing. Bleeker had fair skin and brown hair and wore a skintight black suit while testing the parawings.

Bleeker appeared in the first issue of the comic-book miniseries Star Wars: Agent of the Empire. The comic was written by John Ostrander, illustrated by Stéphane Roux, and released by Dark Horse Comics
